_note: Creative constraint deck (ADR-0026). Drawn with `uika creative deck`. Weaker models collapse to the modal answer when asked to 'be creative'; divergence has to be injected from outside the model. Add cards freely; keep each card concrete (a noun you can draw, a rule you can check). Owner's picks (uika creative pick) tell you which cards earn their place.

world.text: A ship's log kept in ink: dated entries, dead reckoning, a barometer, a course line that corrects itself. Motion verb: 'steer'.
A lighthouse keeper's instrument room: brass dials, a rotating beam that reveals things only when it sweeps past them. Motion verb: 'sweep'.
A railway timetable and departure board: rows that flip, one train that is never late, platforms as categories. Motion verb: 'depart'.
A seismograph drum: a continuous paper roll, one needle, quiet stretches that make the spike meaningful. Motion verb: 'trace'.
A library card catalog: drawers, index cards, a hand-stamped due date, one card pulled out and turned over. Motion verb: 'file'.
A stage manager's cue sheet: 'standby / go' calls, a dark stage lit one pool at a time, actors as data points. Motion verb: 'cue'.
A photographic darkroom: an image surfacing in developer, red safelight, a print pegged to dry. Motion verb: 'develop'.
A cartographer's survey: benchmarks, triangulation lines, a blank region marked 'unsurveyed' that stays blank on purpose. Motion verb: 'survey'.
A tide table and a harbor wall: a level that rises and falls on a schedule, a mark for the highest recorded water. Motion verb: 'rise and fall'.
An apothecary's drawers: labeled jars, exact weights on a balance, a warning label taken seriously. Motion verb: 'weigh'.
An orchestra tuning up: many uncoordinated voices settle to one reference pitch; the conductor's raised hand is the cut. Motion verb: 'tune'.
A telegraph office: paper tape, clicking keys, a message arriving letter by letter, a stamp at the end. Motion verb: 'transmit'.
A clockmaker's bench: gear trains, an escapement, one part shown to be the reason the rest keeps time. Motion verb: 'wind'.
A naturalist's field notebook: pencil sketches with labels, pressed specimens, a margin note that contradicts the entry. Motion verb: 'observe'.

constraint.text: One continuous camera move from first frame to last, no cuts; scenes hand off inside the move.
The headline number is the very last thing to appear; everything before it builds the question it answers.
Show the failure, the caveat or the negative result before any success; let it set the stakes.
No on-screen phrase longer than four words except a sourced figure and its source line.
A single object transforms through every beat instead of a new graphic per beat.
One color means one thing, and changes meaning exactly once, at the turning point.
Two beats of near silence; the loudest sound in the piece lands on the claim, not on the title.
Every beat ends on a deliberately empty frame (12 frames) before the next begins; no cross-fades.
Show the shape of the data first, unlabeled, and let the viewer predict; then reveal the label.
The first five seconds contain no UI chrome, no title bar and no logo: only the subject.
Composition is off-center by rule; symmetry is allowed exactly once, for the end card.
Sound leads picture by about ten frames on every cut, so the ear announces each change.

signature.text: Derive one beat from the MECHANISM (how it works), not from its metrics. If the beat would still make sense for a different subject, discard it.
Draw the rule as a physical machine that runs once, in view, end to end.
Make the caveat the most designed beat in the piece, not a footnote.
Show one real trace (a request, a tick, a run) played back at human speed, with its source on screen.
Open a beat with the strongest objection a skeptic would raise, then answer it with evidence.
Answer with a before and after inside the same frame, so the change is the graphic.

forbid.text: An orbiting camera around a torus, sphere, icosahedron or wireframe crystal as the centerpiece.
Glowing teal, cyan or amber on near-black as the whole identity.
A row of three identical stat cards.
A window with a title bar and centered text as the main visual of a beat.
A count-up number on a dark panel as the climax.
The same fade-in, hold, fade-out shape on every beat.
Centered title, subtitle and rule as the opener.
Stock 'AI' imagery: brains, particles, network graphs, floating cubes.
